model_family_disagreement.rationale: V3.1B vs V3.3/V3.5 diversity is scientifically distinct but secondary to the primary pair

outcome_distribution_spread.rationale: V3.5 marginal spread where applicable; MUST NOT be relabeled sampling uncertainty or aleatoric uncertainty

strategy_counterfactual_mc_sampling.rationale: reference existing frozen V3.6/V3.7 sampling evidence with shared vocabulary; do not reinterpret as causal confidence

temporal_instability.rationale: needs its own alignment/persistence contract before use

epistemic_aleatoric_rule: labels PROHIBITED unless the mathematical construction supports the decomposition; disagreement is not epistemic, outcome spread is not calibrated aleatoric

U1_DISAGREEMENT.meaning: divergence between scientifically distinct inference mechanisms (V3.1B vs MC2-E) on the same causally aligned state/driver

U2_MC_SAMPLING.meaning: finite-simulation sampling variability of p_hat=k/n; uncertainty in the Monte Carlo ESTIMATE
U2_MC_SAMPLING.reducing_n_effect: increasing n may reduce U2 while leaving every other family unchanged

is_not: probability that the simulator is wrong
U3_SIMULATOR_SENSITIVITY.meaning: variation of MC2 outputs under a predeclared set of scientifically defensible parameter perturbations; SENSITIVITY analysis
U3_SIMULATOR_SENSITIVITY.range_rule: perturbation range ONLY from fitted uncertainty / empirical distribution / documented calibration range / justified domain source / frozen evidence; arbitrary percentages PROHIBITED

representation: VECTOR / structured evidence bundle {disagreement, mc_sampling, simulator_sensitivity}, never a scalar
